name: SentinelOne Agent Tampering Command
description: Detects command-line attempts to stop, disable, delete, or terminate SentinelAgent; authorized maintenance and removal are expected false positives.
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: SentinelOne Installation Binary Modified or Removed
description: Detects modification, deletion, or rename of SentinelOne executable content. Verify signed updater activity before treating an event as malicious.
query: file where event.action in ("modification", "deletion", "rename") and file.path : "C:\\Program Files\\SentinelOne\\Sentinel Agent\\*" and file.extension in ("exe", "dll", "sys")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: SentinelOne Agent Service Registry Tampering
description: Detects changes to registry values controlling SentinelAgent startup, executable image, recovery, or service logon; authorized installers can also change these values.
query: registry where registry.path : "*\\Services\\SentinelAgent*" and registry.value in ("Start", "ImagePath", "FailureActions", "ObjectName")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: SentinelOne Agent Process Termination
description: Detects SentinelAgent process termination. This is a low-specificity signal that requires correlation because shutdown, upgrades, and authorized administration also terminate the process.
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
